index.head_title: Wenxiaozhou · Multi-host AI Assistant for WPS Office
index.lead: A single TaskPane running across WPS Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation, and PDF. Hook up multiple LLMs (Codex / OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure / OpenAI-compatible — 15 presets) plus two-way MCP, and let AI read and write documents directly through 149 tools — conditional formatting, charts, comment & revision review, PPT generation, PDF translation, all in a single chat.

features.title: Universal TaskPane
features.desc: A unified panel for Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation, and PDF. Presentation presets are encapsulated into a separate WPS dialog window.

features.title: Multi-protocol · Multi-LLM
features.desc: Codex / Anthropic / native Gemini / Azure OpenAI / OpenAI Responses + OpenAI-compatible — 15 presets, plus two-way MCP to reach external tools. Switch anytime via provider groupings.

features.title: 149 Tools, Direct Editing
features.desc: From reading & writing text to conditional formatting / data validation / charts / tables / sparklines, comment & revision review, paragraph & page layout, animations / SmartArt, export PDF / save-as / print — AI acts through tools.

features.title: Multimodal + Live Reasoning
features.desc: Attach images or PDFs as context; reasoning streams live in arrival order, with parameters auto-mapped per provider.

features.title: PPT Themes & Charts
features.desc: 50+ design palettes and 17 HTML layouts. AI generates and rewrites themes, charts and layouts directly, with a drag-and-drop visual editor.

features.title: Out-of-the-box · Cross-platform
features.desc: Built-in portable Node runtime. Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, including domestic OS like Kylin and UOS.

docs.lead: A comprehensive Beta installation manual covering WPS Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation, and PDF. Detailed steps for Windows, macOS, and Linux (including domestic OS like openEuler, Anolis, etc.).

modes.name: Permanent Install
modes.desc: Registers the plugin for all three WPS applications at once. The background service automatically starts on boot. No terminal required.

modes.name: Dev / Debug Mode
modes.desc: Uses npm run dev:*. Only applies to one host at a time and disappears once the script is closed.

docs.callout_overview: We recommend reading the 'Permanent Install' section first. If you just want to test it once, skip to 'Dev / Debug Mode'.
win_steps: Double-click setup.exe and follow the wizard to install into C:\Program Files\LingxiAI (no admin rights required).
The installer will automatically generate the host variant in %USERPROFILE%\.lingxi-ai\, write publish.xml, register auto-start, and launch the background service.
Fully exit WPS (right-click from the system tray), reopen it, and look for the 'Wenxiaozhou' tab at the top.
mac_steps: Right-click the .pkg -> Open. Unsigned versions will be blocked by Gatekeeper; click 'Open' in the warning dialog to bypass it.
Follow the wizard to install into /Library/Application Support/LingxiAI/ (requires system password once).
postinstall automatically selects Node based on CPU architecture, generates host variant to ~/.lingxi-ai/, writes publish.xml, and configures LaunchAgent.
Fully exit WPS -> Reopen any WPS app, and look for the 'Wenxiaozhou' tab at the top.
docs.info_win_uninstall_desc: Start Menu -> 'Wenxiaozhou' -> 'Uninstall Wenxiaozhou'. This automatically stops the service, clears publish.xml and ~/.lingxi-ai, and removes the auto-start entry.
docs.info_win_upgrade_desc: Simply download the new setup.exe and run it. Inno Setup will replace it in place. Provider settings, OAuth Tokens, and model choices are saved in localStorage and won't be lost.
docs.info_mac_uninstall_desc: Search 'Wenxiaozhou Uninstall' in Spotlight or double-click 'Wenxiaozhou Uninstall.app' in Applications -> Enter system password. The script removes LaunchAgent, publish.xml, the installation directory, and the pkgutil receipt.
docs.info_mac_upgrade_desc: Download the new .pkg -> Right-click and open it. preinstall stops the old service, and postinstall rewrites publish.xml and restarts LaunchAgent.
docs.linux_intro: Available in three package formats covering mainstream overseas and domestic Linux distributions, as well as domestic CPUs (LoongArch/SW64/RISC-V). Choose your package from the table below; the post-installation steps are identical.

linux_formats.target: Ubuntu · Debian · Deepin · UOS · openKylin Desktop
openEuler · Anolis OS · Kylin Server · NeoKylin · Fedora · RHEL · UOS Server
Universal for all distros · LoongArch / SW64 / RISC-V CPUs (requires pre-installed Node 18+)

linux_steps: Choose package by distro: deb (Ubuntu/UOS/Kylin), rpm (openEuler/Kylin Server), or tar.gz (Universal fallback).
One-line installation (apt / dnf / tar). The maintainer script automatically detects the real logged-in user and runs user-space configurations.

post-install automatically selects Node via uname -m, generates host variants in ~/.lingxi-ai/, and writes publish.xml to 8 known WPS jsaddons paths (covering snap, flatpak, and UOS Linglong sandbox).

Writes and enables ~/.config/systemd/user/lingxi-ai.service; runs loginctl enable-linger to ensure the service runs even when logged out. Falls back to ~/.config/autostart/.desktop if systemd is unavailable.
Fully exit WPS -> Reopen any WPS app, the 'Wenxiaozhou' tab will appear.
docs.linux_info_arch_desc: x86_64 (Mainstream) + aarch64 (Kunpeng 920 / Phytium D2000) have built-in Node 22. loongarch64 (Loongson) / sw_64 (Shenwei) / mips64el use the .tar.gz package and require a system-installed Node 18+.
docs.linux_info_upg_desc: sudo dpkg -i ./new-version.deb or sudo dnf install ./new-version.rpm overwrites in place. postinst stops the old systemd unit and restarts after install. Settings and tokens in localStorage remain intact.

reqs.note: Both domestic and international versions. Windows 12.x+, macOS 5.x+, Linux WPS 11.x+.
GUI installers have built-in portable Node. Manual setups or domestic CPUs require 18+ / 20+.
Required for Linux permanent mode only. Enabled by default on mainstream distros; falls back to XDG autostart on CentOS 7/containers.
Required for debug mode only. The script runs npm install -g wpsjs automatically.

docs.debug_intro: Best for quick local testing or making code changes. Can only be applied to one host application at a time.
debug_win_steps: Go to the plugin/ folder and double-click install-windows.bat. It checks for Node, globally installs wpsjs, and runs npm install.
Keep the window open and double-click the startup script for your target app: start-wps.bat / start-et.bat / start-wpp.bat.
The script launches a local CORS proxy (3890) + wpsjs debug service (3889), and automatically opens the WPS client.
Find the 'Wenxiaozhou' group in the top ribbon and click 'Open Wenxiaozhou'.
debug_mac_steps: Open terminal and cd into the plugin/ folder.
Run bash install-mac.sh (invoking via bash bypasses Gatekeeper quarantine).
Run the startup script: bash start-wps.sh / start-et.sh / start-wpp.sh.
Reopen WPS. If the group doesn't appear, enable lingxi-ai in the 'Add-ins' panel.
debug_linux_steps: Extract the .tar.gz package to any directory or git clone the repo.
cd into the plugin/ folder and install Node 18+ (if not using built-in).
Run npm install to install dependencies.
Run npm run dev:wps / dev:et / dev:wpp / dev:pdf to start the dev service for the target host.
WPS will be launched automatically by wpsjs. The 'Wenxiaozhou' tab will appear in the Add-ins panel.
Make code changes -> simply refresh the WPS Add-ins panel, no need to restart the script.

faqs.q: Charts / Visual templates report 'Proxy server returned 404' after plugin loads
faqs.a: The proxy server is an old process (didn't have the /upload-image route when started). In debug mode, press Ctrl-C to restart the script; in permanent mode, just rerun the install script.

faqs.q: Cannot see the 'Wenxiaozhou' group in WPS
faqs.a: Permanent mode: Check if the scheduled task / LaunchAgent is registered and look at server.log for errors. Debug mode: Fully exit WPS (use right-click Quit on macOS Dock) and reopen.
In debug mode, append --port to the dev command in package.json, or set the PROXY_PORT env var. In permanent mode, use LINGXI_STATIC_PORT / PROXY_PORT to start.
Yes. First run npm install -g wpsjs on an internet-connected machine, then copy wpsjs along with plugin/node_modules to the identical location on the target machine.

faqs.q: macOS reports 'Main resource content verification failed'
faqs.a: WKWebView has cached old resources. Stop the service -> Clear ~/Library/Containers/com.kingsoft.wpsoffice.mac[.global]/Data/Library/Caches/* -> Restart the service.

faqs.q: macOS running ./xxx.sh directly reports operation not permitted
faqs.a: The zip extraction added the com.apple.quarantine attribute. Solutions: run 'bash xxx.sh', or run 'xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .'.
Temporarily exit 360 before installing, then restart it and whitelist the installation directory; or 'Always Allow' all LingxiAI entries in 360's action log.

faqs.q: Linux installation succeeds but 'Wenxiaozhou' tab doesn't appear
faqs.a: 99% of the time, the jsaddons path is incorrect. Check ~/.lingxi-ai/install.log to see where publish.xml was written, then run 'find ~/.config ~/.kingsoft ~/.linglong -name publish.xml' to see what WPS is actually reading. Add the missing path to PUBLISH_DIRS in plugin/tools/post-install-linux.sh.

faqs.q: Kylin V10 early versions fail to start service via systemctl --user
faqs.a: Early V10 (based on Ubuntu 18.04, glibc 2.27) cannot run Node 22. The script falls back to 'node' in PATH; run 'sudo apt install nodejs' (18+) first, then rerun 'bash /opt/lingxi-ai/plugin/tools/post-install-linux.sh /opt/lingxi-ai'. Or upgrade to V10 SP1+.

faqs.q: How to install on LoongArch / Shenwei systems?
faqs.a: Use the .tar.gz package (no built-in node). Use 'sudo apt install nodejs' for Loongnix/Kylin or install from OEM repo for Shenwei. After installing, run 'bash install.sh'; post-install automatically uses the system node.

faqs.q: WPS installed from UOS App Store doesn't show 'Wenxiaozhou'
faqs.a: The UOS Linglong sandboxed WPS might not be able to access 127.0.0.1:3889. The script writes publish.xml into the sandbox directory, but if network isolation blocks local ports, you must use the official deb version of WPS installed outside the sandbox.

changelog.lead: Grow with Wenxiaozhou. All released installers and source code are available on the GitHub Releases page.

items: Improved compatibility with newer WPS versions.
Fixed Gemini model compatibility and request handling.
Fixed Codex authorization failing to fetch the model list.
Fixed the add-in getting stuck on startup when the local proxy uses a different port, and improved proxy connections during Windows local development.

releases.summary: A big multi-protocol expansion (native Google Gemini / Azure OpenAI / generic OpenAI Responses, 15 presets in total with OpenAI-compatible), two-way MCP (Server exposing WPS tools to external agents, and Client connecting to external MCP services), live reasoning echo, and a one-shot batch of 49 host tools (conditional formatting / data validation / charts / sparklines / tables / comment read-write / revision review / paragraph & page layout / animation / SmartArt / export PDF / save-as / print), bringing the host-tool count to 149.

items: Multi-protocol: added native Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, and generic OpenAI Responses, for 15 presets in total with OpenAI-compatible aggregators — hook up several at once and switch anytime.

Two-way MCP: besides exposing WPS tools to external agents (Claude Code / Claude Desktop / Cursor), it can now act as a client connecting to external MCP services (local stdio / remote SSE), bringing their tools into the conversation under the mcp__service__tool namespace.

Spreadsheet: conditional formatting (color scales / data bars / icon sets / above-average / top-N / duplicates), data validation (dropdown / numeric range / custom), native charts, sparklines, tables, remove duplicates, text-to-columns, subtotals, advanced filter.

Writer: paragraph layout (alignment / indent / line spacing / spacing), headers & footers / page numbers, page setup, footnotes, captions, watermark, revision review (read + accept/reject per-item or all), style list, text boxes, merge documents.
Presentation: shape animation, align & distribute, SmartArt, sections, click actions / hyperlinks, audio & video insertion.
Cross-host: read & write comments, one-click export to PDF, save-as, print, document properties, view zoom & navigation.
Live reasoning echo: reasoning tokens now stream in arrival order instead of piling up after the answer; Gemini 2.5 recognized as reasoning models across the board.
AI revision mode: AI edits to a document can be applied as native Word tracked changes — accept / reject per-item or all at once, so you can see exactly what changed and roll it back.

Writer tools preserve document objects: replacing text now protects images / tables / equations from being wiped (read tools inject [Image N] / [Table N] placeholders; writes replace segment-by-segment).
New Writer tools: scan red / highlighted / shaded text (wps_find_colored_text) and batch-clear formatting (wps_clear_text_formatting).

Chat UI overhaul: a Claude-style timeline (node dots + per-segment tool / thinking durations, with the collapsed row showing that segment's total), always-visible per-message Copy / Fill-to-input buttons, right-aligned user messages, and a task list collapsed by default.
Selectable thinking effort: thinking effort is now chosen from a pop-up list (current item checked).
History in its own window: past conversations open in a standalone system window floating over the document, grouped by Today / Last 7 days / Older.
Dedicated image tab: image-generation progress moved to its own "Image" tab instead of taking over the chat area.
Fixed dropped text when delta.content streams as array parts (some gateways / Azure).
Fixed Azure OpenAI auth (api-key header + deployment + api-version) and Gemini auth (x-goog-api-key) passing through the local proxy.
Print / save-as / export and other side-effecting actions now confirm target and intent before running.
Rate-limit hits (rpm / 429) now show a friendly message explaining it's a rate limit rather than an error.

releases.summary: A brand-new bilingual (Chinese / English) UI, AI formatting templates (contract / official / paper, etc.), comment-based proofreading and document compliance checks, AI edit-following, long-conversation compression and cross-conversation memory, new OpenAI / OpenRouter and Boogu local image channels, export to a new Word file, plus fixes for repeated cutout-model downloads, tool-call errors on thinking models like DeepSeek, garbled Chinese paste on macOS, the macOS model dropdown, small-screen input area, MCP and install stability.

items: Full internationalization: Simplified Chinese / English UI, following the system language by default and switchable under Settings → Language; covers Ribbon buttons, dialog titles and native dialogs, taking effect instantly (Ribbon labels after restarting WPS).

AI formatting templates: built-in Contract / Official document / Academic paper / Notice templates with a style preview and a full-page sample; custom templates (font, size, alignment for each heading level / body / quote); official & paper templates support Chinese chapter auto-numbering (一、/（一）/ 1.1), page margins and page-break-before on level-1 headings.
AI formatting scope: format only the selection or the whole document, each with its own preview & confirm.
AI edit-following: while the AI edits, Word scrolls to the change and Excel selects the edited range so you can see where it's working (can be turned off in Settings).
Comment-based proofreading: the new Proofread action marks typos / grammar / punctuation / logic issues as Word comments at their exact positions — click a comment to jump there.

Document compliance check: paste a checklist (tender requirements / contract review points / internal rules) and the AI reviews the whole document against it, marking findings as Word comments graded high / medium / low.

More image channels: added OpenAI official and OpenRouter image-generation channels; added a Boogu local image channel (self-hosted, no API key, generation only — no cutout), with a configurable default resolution tier (768 / 1K / 1080p / 2K / ultra) that derives width & height from the aspect ratio, and support for connecting to a self-hosted remote generation service.
Weak-model tool-call hint: when a model runs a tool but only restates the tool name instead of using its result, chat suggests switching to a stronger model.
Ribbon quick actions collapse into an action box: the fixed prompt sent by a Ribbon button folds into a single line in chat and expands to show the full prompt; history replays the same way.

Cheaper long conversations: very long chats automatically compress earlier turns into a rolling summary while keeping the most recent turns verbatim, avoiding runaway token growth and context-limit errors.
Cross-conversation memory: a new conversation automatically carries over preferences and conclusions from earlier conversations on the same document.
Local quick commands: deterministic commands like Save, Go to page N, Insert an N×M table, Undo / Redo run locally with zero latency and no token cost.
Export to a new Word file: save the formatted result as a new Word document without touching the current one.
Steadier outline-to-slides: the AI reviews and completes the outline (chapters / hierarchy) before generating the deck.
Replies stay in the UI language: fixed foreign models replying in English; the reasoning process is constrained too.
New MCP tool reveal_location: external AI can actively locate and highlight a region to guide the user's attention.
The task-progress panel can now collapse / expand; the model dropdown shows all models of tested providers by default, no manual refresh needed.

Background long tasks (proofreading / compliance, etc.) now share unified status tracking with visible progress / logs and resumable interruption; conversation persistence is now idle-throttled for smoother rapid sending in long chats.
Fixed the top model dropdown being unclickable on macOS.
Fixed the bottom chat input area being squeezed on small / short windows so the Stop button couldn't be clicked; the "AI working" banner is now a compact single line.

Fixed installs aborting because an old background service wasn't stopped, and the background watchdog wrongly deciding WPS wasn't running and stopping the service — which made the Ribbon entry disappear.
Fixed the MCP toggle showing unchanged after saving and reopening Settings; fixed external agents' MCP call logs not showing in the settings window.
Fixed the Ribbon quick-action "action box" being lost when replaying chat history (older records are restored from their prompt where possible).
Fixed the dev environment picking a Node binary from another platform when multiple platform runtimes coexist.

Fixed local cutout re-downloading the model every time: when the download was interrupted by a WebView request timeout / cancel, the partially downloaded model is no longer discarded — it finishes and caches in the background so the next cutout is instant.

Fixed thinking-mode models like DeepSeek failing with "Thinking mode does not support this tool_choice" when a tool call was forced (e.g. reading a spreadsheet) — it now automatically retries without the forced tool_choice.
Fixed garbled Chinese when pasting into the chat input box on macOS.

Fixed slow local image generation (e.g. Boogu) being wrongly treated as failed due to the WebView 60s timeout and retried repeatedly — it now generates asynchronously in the background with progress polling.

releases.summary: All local caches migrated to SQLite, selectively enable Office apps, a service-status panel, AI operating WPS directly, plus tagged material library with multi-source collection, AI cutout and local offline cutout, dual-channel PDF parallel translation / summary / Q&A, staged PPT image generation, cloud skills, a token-usage panel, table support in AI formatting, and much more.

items: All desktop local caches migrated to SQLite (via the bundled Node proxy): no longer bound by the browser's localStorage size / quota; conversations / history / token stats / materials / skills etc. are written through a server-side atomic merge across hosts — consistent and preserved across restarts.
New 'Service Status' settings page: view the ports and memory used by the local background service.
Selectively enable Word / Excel / PPT / PDF: tick them in settings to load Wenxiaozhou only in the chosen apps (takes effect after restarting WPS).
AI operation mode now defaults to 'operate WPS directly' (no per-step confirmation); the mode option was renamed, with the 'preview & confirm' mode still available.
Settings / material panels migrated to Ant Design Vue for a more consistent UI.
Material project name is now auto-summarized by the AI once per conversation: materials are auto-tagged with the project when acquired, and the manual 'current project' input was removed.

AI formatting now supports soft-line-break documents and markdown tables: a document split by Shift+Enter into a single Word paragraph can still be formatted line by line, and markdown tables are turned into native Word tables on replace.

Material library overhaul: materials now carry a project tag plus content tags; generated images are auto-tagged, and when building docs / PPTs the AI can search and reuse existing materials by tag instead of regenerating.
Import local images into the material library, with content tags auto-generated by a vision model; added text search and project filtering.
New web_fetch (scrape a web page's text) and web_image_search (find images online) tools that save web data / online images into the library as materials.
Staged PPT generation: the whole deck is inserted instantly with placeholder skeletons for preview, while images generate in the background and each page is swapped in once all its images are ready.
Cloud skills: load skills from a cloud (OSS) directory and enable the ones you want — no manual import needed.
New 'Token Usage' panel: per-model input / output / call counts, persisted, with a current-session subtotal.
Ribbon actions (expand / translate / polish, etc.) now factor in the document title, outline and surrounding context so output no longer drifts off-topic.
AI writes back to Word using native Word formatting (headings / lists / tables) directly, instead of emitting markdown and converting it.
Material library AI cutout / brush editing: one-click background removal, or brush over the subject to inpaint / cut it out (Codex-bridge channel).
Local offline cutout: a built-in neural matting model (onnxruntime + isnet) with hair-level soft edges, works with any model, fully offline; the model is fetched from the cloud on first use.
AI image generation can set the aspect ratio per run; generated images can be cropped into new materials; material preview supports scroll-to-zoom; the library now uses a masonry layout.
Document mind maps now render offline with markmap, with a Q&A panel for the map on the right, and can be turned into an image saved to the material library.
The model dropdown at the top of chat can collapse / expand by provider.

PDF parallel translation / full-text summary / PDF Q&A were reworked into a dual channel: digital PDFs extract page-numbered text (readable by any model, cheaper, accurate page references), while scanned PDFs fall back to whole-file multimodal.

PDF parallel translation is now a standalone window: pick source / target language and whole-doc / specific pages, preserve the original layout as much as possible, with a streaming original / translation comparison table.
When a model doesn't support images / attachments, show an actionable message instead of the cryptic 'Unexpected item type in content'.
In 'preview & confirm' mode, fixed the confirm dialog being unclickable after it popped up (the document lock had disabled task-pane interaction), and made the dialog smaller.

Forwarding timeout is now idle-based: as long as SSE keeps returning it isn't a timeout, so reasoning models that think for a while / large gaps between chunks are no longer killed (timeouts are configurable via env vars).
Fixed an extra newline on manual paste on Windows; show a 'Pasting…' overlay when a manual paste is stuck.

Fixed the background service failing to start (a missing file) and WPS showing no plugin entry after install; the three-platform uninstallers now clean up residue (including the SQLite DB, the background launcher process, Linux linger, etc.).
Fixed the proxy crashing when started with an old Node that lacks node:sqlite.
Fixed AI formatting treating a whole document as one paragraph (only one heading) and 'only the title left after replace'.
Fixed mac Word ribbon icon / button display issues; improved PDF plugin callbacks and local-debug compatibility; fixed model-test filtering, provider expand state, local proxy forwarding and more.

Fixed input-box editing shortcuts (Ctrl+C/V etc.) being intercepted by the document on the left; translation replace now keeps line breaks and no longer sticks to the next paragraph; hardened the AddPicture null case in one-click PPT generation.
Fixed streaming chat breaking on gateways that strictly validate the request body and reject the stream_options field with a 400 (now retries without it).
A pass of bug hunting and fixes across runtime / providers / tools / installers.
Site download page: fixed SSR manifest state, platform detection and download links.

Fixed the PDF parallel-translation / Q&A dialog getting stuck because a page-number example in the prompt was mistaken for a required input; fixed some WPS versions not reading the PDF attachment so the AI 'couldn't see the PDF'.
Fixed the pending-tools area squeezing the chat transcript down to a few messages after a turn that called several tools.
Cutout / inpaint now show visible progress and can be cancelled; fixed the cutout result not being a transparent PNG.

releases.summary: Change-history restore overhaul, true typewriter AI Format preview, and Linux Kylin install fix.

items: Change history entries are preserved after restore — UI shows a 'Restored' badge and hides the rollback button; full history survives TaskPane reload.
Smart turn title derivation: short prompts as-is; long or empty prompts derived from tool friendly names (e.g. 'Replace selection · Apply paragraph style'), original prompt as hover tooltip.
Multi-step undo restore: older turns now also use the no-close Application.Undo path (auto-counts steps), no longer closes and reopens the document every time.
AI Format preview is now a true typewriter: completed blocks stay static, only the active block at the bottom has a blinking cursor and types char-by-char — no more full-panel flashing.
Download page URL / filename / size are all driven from OSS manifest.json, so the site no longer lags behind actual releases.

Linux install fix on Kylin V10: post-install-linux.sh under set -u was expanding the systemd unit's positional args ($2) as undefined script variables and aborting, leaving the systemd unit incomplete and the service unable to start.
When restoring a middle turn, cascade-mark all newer turns as restored so their buttons disappear too (their backups are out-of-sync after the rollback).
Linux packaging adds a Docker container path so tar.gz / deb / rpm all build on Mac too; Apple Silicon uses --platform=linux/amd64 to force x64 builds.
Nuxt 3 dev server on Windows binds to IPv6 by default causing a blank localhost — forced to 127.0.0.1.

releases.summary: A focused polish pass on ribbon UX, streaming previews, and cross-platform packaging.

items: Ribbon actions (polish / shrink / rewrite / expand / translate / continue / summary / mindmap) now share a unified preview dialog with before/after highlights, streaming output, and one-click rollback.
AI Format adds Contract / Tender / Government / Notice / Paper / Proposal / Resume presets; without a prompt it auto-detects the document type.
Image generation moved to a dedicated progress panel and auto-picks 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 based on context.
Default model ID is now a dropdown picker populated from the fetched model list.
Local proxy port falls forward through 3890-3909 when busy; the client rediscovers it via /healthz.
Chat retries up to 5 times on stream interruption.
New manual unlock button to clear edit-restricted state left over after undo.
Ribbon actions check the document is saved first, with OS-aware Ctrl+S / ⌘+S hints.
Polish / translate replacements preserve the original font, paragraph style, and line breaks; no more shrinking the heading that follows the selection.
Friendly message when no model is configured, replacing the misleading OAuth login error.
macOS installer switched to .pkg — right-click → Open to bypass Gatekeeper.
Linux packaging now supports a Docker container path so tar.gz / deb / rpm all build cleanly on macOS too.

releases.summary: Added Linux permanent installation and upgraded the PPT/HTML templates, visual editing, theme presets, and in-app update experience.

items: Added Linux permanent installers across .deb, .rpm, and .tar.gz formats, covering Kylin, UOS, openEuler, Anolis, NeoKylin, and other distributions.
Expanded the HTML template system to 17 layouts, including cover, section, content, stat, feature-grid, timeline, bento, and freeform.
Added a visual HTML preview editor with drag, 8-direction resize, multi-select, alignment guides, 6px snapping, and coordinate hints.
Moved PPT style presets into a dedicated dialog with a visual theme grid and live preview.
Added in-app update prompts and a one-click update flow, with a visible 'New version' state in the top bar.
Added image generation support for toapis and codex-bridge providers, with clearer messages for common provider-side blocking errors.
Improved local Ollama model recommendations so users can choose better local models for their workflow.
Improved Linux WPS add-in path detection, including WPS365 and UOS Linglong sandbox locations.
Improved permanent-install uninstall and upgrade flows to reduce service leftovers and missing plugin paths after upgrades.

releases.summary: Extended PDF host and multimodal support, rebuilt provider management and settings, and made the TaskPane layout better suited for daily use.

items: Added PDF host support so WPS PDF can share the same TaskPane capabilities as Writer, Spreadsheets, and Presentation.
Added PDF multimodal attachments for model understanding, rewriting, and summarization alongside image and document context.
Added reasoning-strength settings with automatic parameter mapping per provider.
Rebuilt multi-provider management for unified switching across Codex, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible providers, and custom endpoints.
Moved settings into dialogs and redesigned the TaskPane around a more flexible layout.
Added floating resize handles to improve dragging across narrow panels and different WPS hosts.
Improved recovery and retry behavior, and removed debug attributes to reduce accidental debug exposure in production.

releases.summary: Added support for Anthropic Claude 3 models and improved service stability on Linux.

items: Added support for Claude 3 Opus / Sonnet
Allowed custom model API proxies in settings
Fixed WPS add-in detection when running WPS through Flatpak on Linux
Fixed conversation streams not retrying after network interruptions

releases.summary: Improved PPT generation and style presets, adding five new templates.

items: Added Timeline / Bento PPT layout templates
Added a keyboard shortcut to open the TaskPane (Win: Ctrl+Shift+A)
Refactored the internal tool-use scheduler for faster responses
Updated the built-in Node.js runtime to v22 LTS
